title: sophora moorcroftiana
intro: Sophora moorcroftiana, commonly known as the 'Tibetan Sophora', is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Sophora moorcroftiana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isoflavonoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
